title: Debit Returned on a Won Chargeback Case, Northloop Payments
content:
**Rule.** A chargeback debit is returned only on a case whose dispute is recorded as won, and it is booked as one returned-debit entry on that case. The debit returned on a won case is its return basis, rounded to the cent. The return basis is the chargeback debit booked on the case, except that when the won dispute was submitted on refund-already-issued evidence it is the lesser of the chargeback debit on the case and the seller-funded refund debits booked on the same order, so that the seller does not bear the refund and the chargeback for the same order amount.

## Records read

| Quantity | Record |
|---|---|
| Whether the case is won | the dispute status recorded on the chargeback case |
| Chargeback debit on the case | the chargeback debit booked on the Northloop Payments ledger for that case |
| Evidence of the won dispute | the evidence type on which the won dispute was submitted |
| Seller-funded refund debits on the same order | the refund debits booked on the ledger for the order the chargeback is on |

## Return basis by evidence

| Evidence the won dispute was submitted on | Return basis |
|---|---|
| refund already issued | the lesser of the chargeback debit on the case and the seller-funded refund debits on the same order |
| any other evidence, such as proof of delivery, signature confirmation or item as described | the chargeback debit booked on the case |

## Hypothetical worked examples

- *Won on proof of delivery; chargeback debit 180.00 USD.* The return basis is 180.00 USD and the debit returned is 180.00 USD.
- *Won on refund-already-issued evidence; chargeback debit 180.00 USD; seller-funded refund debits on the same order 120.00 USD.* The lesser of 180.00 and 120.00 is 120.00, so 120.00 USD is returned.
- *Won on refund-already-issued evidence; chargeback debit 75.50 USD; refund debits on the order 90.00 USD.* The lesser is 75.50, so 75.50 USD is returned.
- *Dispute lost, or not yet decided.* The case is not recorded as won, and no debit is returned on it.
